build_receipt_verification.source_digest_algorithm: sha256(concat(files in native sorted(Path.rglob('*')) order: relative POSIX path UTF-8 + NUL + raw file SHA-256 digest))
required_checks: Pre-build source digest and file count match prepare source manifest
After-build source digest and file count also match, and source_stable_during_build is true
Configure/build steps both successful; targets null; no targeted command
Every supplied binary path, size and SHA-256 matches a receipt artifact
Frozen source copy agrees with initial manifest; frozen receipt copy hash agrees with supplied receipt
build_receipt_verification.supported_mismatch_handling: Reject preparation for source/count/binary mismatches, failed/partial builds or missing/mismatched stability fields before any candidate copy
build_receipt_verification.receipt_retention: Copy supplied receipt into the case; preserve origin identity; recheck frozen receipt and binding at preflight
build_receipt_verification.limits: Consistency of a locally supplied build receipt is not independent compiler attestation or a reproducible-build proof. Matching endpoint hashes cannot exclude source changes followed by reversion between endpoints.
build_receipt_verification.new_test_coverage: Supported matching receipt, explicit absent/legacy labels, source digest/count mismatch, changed or differently located binary, failed build, partial or targeted build, missing build step, unstable/changed/missing after-state, independent hash framing and native path ordering
build_receipt_verification.prepared_case_status: Prepared and preflight passed; no runtime executed. Source, input snapshots, build receipt and three candidate binaries retained and verified.
build_receipt_verification.prepared_case_preflight_result: freeze_intact true; all three selected XML references present; no absolute/escape values detected in bounded XML scan; runtime readiness not established

superseded_case.status: preparation only; superseded by final v2 build; no runtime or preflight after coordinator hold

historical_oracle_qualification: Historical corpus bytes/provenance are retained as input, never promoted to fresh-reference expectations. Oracle B README documents same-process MultiBlow contamination and later fresh reruns; neither an oracle label nor an old plan establishes present runtime state.
comparison_limits: Raw file bytes and added/removed/changed files remain primary; metadata changes are listed separately
No automatic legacy-express, GENCTC, path, numerical or XML/whitespace waiver
Optional qualified views bind full raw digests plus explicit nonoverlapping byte slices, written reason and retained evidence, and leave the raw result unchanged
Local receipts check consistency of operator-declared provenance; they are not independent process attestation or protection against deliberate whole-chain rewriting
Matching final state does not prove architecture, complete reachable dependency recovery, transient effects, write order or overall acceptance
